verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a state tax agency's online filing and payment flow could publish operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts before a user starts. The only evidence is two edge-denial probes (HTTP 403 on www.ftb.ca.gov and webapp.ftb.ca.gov). These show the site could not be read, not that FTB fails to publish such limits, so nothing supports the capability and confidence is low.
